_comment: A cooldown that deals an instant poison hit, 6.3 HP plus 0.8 per level, then a poison burn over 3 ticks at 30-tick intervals, to enemies in a 1.5-unit radius plus 0.05 per level. Numbers mirror the fire version of this skill with the damage type swapped; the first player-castable poison damage in the game. All values placeholder.
name: Envenom
